item.title: Caledonian Hotel to Reopen After More Than a Decade as Stornoway Landmark Returns to Life
item.description: Stornoway’s Caledonian Hotel is set to reopen after more than a decade following investment linked to SSEN Transmission’s Lewis Hub project, bringing a landmark building back into use and paving the way for long term community and economic benefits.The post Caledonian Hotel to Reopen After More Than a Decade as Stornoway Landmark Returns to Life appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Insurance is Not Complicated, it is Made Complicated on Purpose
item.description: As insurance costs rise and trust falls, many people feel trapped in a system designed to confuse rather than protect, where jargon, delays and opaque processes leave customers exhausted, powerless and paying more for less certainty.The post Insurance is Not Complicated, it is Made Complicated on Purpose appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Marines Save Life of Stranded Climber on Ben Nevis in Blizzard Conditions
item.description: Royal and Dutch marines saved the life of a stranded climber on Ben Nevis after finding him near the summit in blizzard conditions, highlighting the dangers of winter climbing and the importance of preparation, training and teamwork.The post Marines Save Life of Stranded Climber on Ben Nevis in Blizzard Conditions appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Festive Drink and Drug Driving Figures Lay Bare Ongoing Risk on Highland Roads
item.description: Festive drink and drug driving figures reveal the ongoing risk on Highland roads, with Police Scotland detecting hundreds of offences over December and January and warning that impaired driving continues to destroy lives year round.The post Festive Drink and Drug Driving Figures Lay Bare Ongoing Risk on Highland Roads appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: A West Highland Home With Space, Views, and Room to Evolve
item.description: Set on the Ardnamurchan Peninsula near Kilchoan, Far View Cottage offers generous living space, sea views towards the Sound of Mull, and flexible accommodation with scope for income or extended family use in a striking West Highland setting.The post A West Highland Home With Space, Views, and Room to Evolve appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Labour Campaign Faces Turmoil After Polling Slumps to 15 Percent
item.description: Labour’s Scottish campaign is under growing pressure after polling slumped to 15 percent, amid allegations over campaign funding, disputed election leaflets, and mounting internal division ahead of the May election.The post Labour Campaign Faces Turmoil After Polling Slumps to 15 Percent appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Ferry Road Design Proposals Shared With Stromness Community
item.description: Residents and businesses in Stromness are being invited to shape new design proposals for Ferry Road and the waterfront, with public events planned to gather feedback on plans aimed at safer journeys and improved access for the whole community.The post Ferry Road Design Proposals Shared With Stromness Community appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: More Than 18,000 Baby Boxes Delivered Across NHS Highland Since 2017
item.description: More than 18,000 Baby Boxes have been delivered to families across NHS Highland since 2017, as new figures highlight the scale of Scotland’s national scheme aimed at giving every child the best possible start in life.The post More Than 18,000 Baby Boxes Delivered Across NHS Highland Since 2017 appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Belladrum Tartan Heart Festival Reveals Second Wave of Artists for 2026
item.description: Belladrum Tartan Heart Festival has revealed its second wave of artists for 2026, with Ella Henderson, Sigala, Skerryvore and more joining an already packed lineup as the Highland festival prepares for another sell out summer.The post Belladrum Tartan Heart Festival Reveals Second Wave of Artists for 2026 appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: SPFL Confirms Final Weekend Dates and European Postponement Policy
item.description: The SPFL has confirmed kick off times for the final weekend of the 2025/26 Premiership season and agreed to continue the round three postponement policy for clubs involved in European competition ahead of the 2026/27 campaign.The post SPFL Confirms Final Weekend Dates and European Postponement Policy appeared first on The Highland Times.
